name: Swan Corp Ltd
about: Swan Energy Limited (SEL) was originally incorporated in 1909 as Swan Mills Ltd. (SML), a manufacturer and marketer of cotton and polyester textile products in India. Over the years, it diversified into Real estate and is developing a Floating Storage and Regasification Units -based liquid natural gas (LNG) import terminal at Jafrabad in Gujarat.[1][2]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
1) Distribution & Development (74% in H1 FY25 vs 21% in FY23): [1] [2] In January 2023, the company completed the acquisition of a majority stake in Veritas India Ltd (VIL) for Rs. 260 Cr. VIL trades and distributes chemicals and petrochemical products used in paint, oil refining, etc. It operates a terminal in Hamriyah, UAE, with a capacity of 1,70,000 MT. [3] [4]
